title: Chain of Explanation: New Prompting Method to Generate Quality Natural Language Explanation for Implicit Hate Speech
reasoning: The paper focuses on a new prompting method for generating explanations for hate speech and evaluates these using linguistic and informativeness metrics. While it includes a brief 'Ethical Considerations' section regarding the data and annotation process, it does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a core component.
